surface: certified Kumar--Shioda split E8 rational elliptic surface
theorem: For every one of the 45 branch pairs, any Q-rational section in the stated polynomial ansatz must have a common coefficient denominator divisible by 41*47*53*61*71*73*79=2550913424887.
proof_method: At each obstruction prime every possible triple of x-coefficients in F_p^3 is exhaustively enumerated, exact divisibility by the twist polynomial is tested, and the quotient is tested for being the square of a polynomial of degree at most two. A rational section integral at p would reduce to one of these nonexistent solutions.
truth_note: Restricted visibility obstruction only. It is not a Mordell--Weil rank upper bound and does not exclude higher-degree or rational-function sections.
